# Credits & licences

## Art, characters, music, sound effects
**All original.** Nothing in this repository was copied, traced or imitated from Nintendo or any other game.
* 3D models: procedural primitives built in `game/core/build.gd`, `game/player/capt_visual.gd`, `game/bosses/boss_visual.gd`, `game/creatures/capturable.gd`, `game/props/*.gd`, `game/world/level_gen.gd`. Toon shader: `game/core/build.gd`.
* UI: drawn in code (`game/ui/*`). Text uses Godot's built-in default font (Open Sans, SIL OFL, bundled with Godot).
* Music: composed algorithmically by `game/audio/music_gen.gd` and rendered by `game/audio/synth.gd` (pre-rendered to `game/audio/music/*.pcm` by `game/tests/render_music.gd`).
* Sound effects: recipes in `game/audio/sfx_bank.gd`, synthesized at runtime.
* Story, dialogue, character and kingdom names: written for this project (`game/story/*.gd`).
* Pocket Edition art: drawn with a tiny raster toolkit in `pocket/tools/art.py` (including a 5×7 pixel font written for this project); levels generated by `pocket/tools/levels.py`; GB/GBC music generated by `pocket/tools/export_gb.py`.

## CC0 / third-party assets
**None used.** If any is added later it must be listed here with source URL and licence.
